name: Synn
message: 「Well, yesterday was pretty rough, so it can't be helped」

name: Synn
message: 「We have the day off today, so let's take it easy」

name: Macaron
message: 「Is it really okay for me to take a break...?」

name: Synn
message: 「You work hard every single day, Macaron, so you need to rest once in a while too, right」

name: Paqy
message: 「The great me will dig in too!」

name: Melphas
message: 「I was thinking I might partake in the meal alongside you all」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, sorry about that. Please, go right ahead」

name: Paqy
message: 「Do you have nothing better to do...?」

name: Melphas
message: 「No. It is merely an incidental stop while paying a visit to inquire after our lovely princess」

name: Melphas
message: 「My, my, though yesterday was quite the commotion, I am glad above all else that you appear to be unharmed」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm totally fine! Or rather, were you peeping again?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Truly regrettable as it is, contrary to my love for the princess, I judged that I would be of no use whatsoever」

name: Synn
message: 「Now, now. Well then, please wait just a moment」

name: Synn
message: 「Say what you will, Melphas really does worry about you properly, huh」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmm, I don't think it's anything like that, though」

name: Macaron
message: 「More importantly, what about you, Big Brother!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, yesterday I was the one who got made to worry way more, though!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, that's true. You really saved me, Macaron」

name: Synn
message: 「Since when did you learn to fight like that without Alzard?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmm~... I was just so desperate about everything... I don't really know」

name: Macaron
message: 「I just thought, I have to protect Big Brother...」

name: Macaron
message: 「My head was completely full of just that, I guess」

name: Synn
message: 「Then does that mean you managed to stop relying on Alzard all thanks to me?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmph! Even though you were practically about to get beaten!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Jeez, I was seriously worried about you, you know!」

name: Synn
message: 「...Though, it might be a little disappointing」

name: Synn
message: 「Macaron throwing a tantrum like a spoiled kid was pretty cute too」
Even an ordinary kitchen knife is scary!

name: Macaron
message: 「Ugh, stop it! Don't make fun of me!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Even if I don't hold everything in anymore...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Because you'll accept all of me, Big Brother...」
Those tantrums back then might have been a reaction to the pressure of having to become the Demon Lord.
But that means all of that has been resolved now.

name: Macaron
message: 「Honestly, thinking you can get away with anything just by calling it cute!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then I won't ever call you cute again」

name: Synn
message: 「I was just thinking how cute you are even when you're being stubborn like that」

name: Synn
message: 「I wouldn't say something that embarrassing if I were lying……」

name: Macaron
message: 「If I get used to it, it'll be a waste, right……\s03」

name: Melphas
message: 「So this is how the two of you affirm the shape of your love day by day, I see」

name: Melphas
message: 「At this rate, no matter how much I whisper words of love, they will never reach the Princess. Truly a pity」

name: Melphas
message: 「Oh dear, I've been terribly uncouth. Well then……」

name: Macaron
message: 「It's because you keep saying unnecessary things, Onii-chan」

name: Macaron
message: 「Geez... You looked kinda cool when you were overwhelming Azel, too...」

name: Synn
message: 「Back then, I was just desperate to save Pasta and the others... I guess」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, if I had been able to fight properly, Ardin would have...」

name: Macaron
message: 「That wasn't your fault, big brother! Don't blame yourself!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Pasta wasn't crying anymore after that, right」

name: Synn
message: 「What we have to do right now is protect this world from Re-Crea」

name: Synn
message: 「Making sure something like that never happens again is what's important, isn't it」

name: Synn
message: 「I can think like that because you're here with me, Macaron」

name: Synn
message: 「I feel like the two of us took one step closer to becoming proper Demon Lords」

name: Macaron
message: 「I wonder if I can face my Master with a little more pride now...」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you want to see your Master?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yeah! We promised that I'd go see him once I became a proper Demon Lord」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ah... Big brother, could it be you're jealous?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Because the me right now has properly realized it」

name: Macaron
message: 「What I felt for Master was admiration for him as a Demon Lord」

name: Macaron
message: 「But with you, big brother, it's even more than that, um...」

name: Macaron
message: 「My heart is pounding so hard it hurts, too, you know...」

name: Synn
message: 「Aah... I think I'm gonna get a nosebleed...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Mmph... Shall I shove a green onion up there for you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Because you keep saying such cute things, Macaron...」

name: Synn
message: 「Aah, my mouth just moved on its own...」

name: Paqy
message: 「...Sorry to interrupt while you're busy, but」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, sorry, I'll get it ready right now!」
Well, there's no doubt I'm an idiot for Macaron.

name: Melphas
message: 「Thank you very much for the wonderful meal today. I'll be taking my leave now.」

name: Paqy
message: 「So he just came here for a free meal after all」

name: Melphas
message: 「I thank you for your kind consideration, Lord President」

name: Melphas
message: 「Have you noticed any changes in your mood or physical condition lately?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Not really, I feel the same as always」

name: Melphas
message: 「Is that so... No, if nothing is amiss, then pay it no mind」

name: Synn
message: 「We take good care of our health, so there's no need to worry」

name: Melphas
message: 「Ah, yes, of course, I have complete faith in you」

name: Macaron
message: 「I can take care of myself just fine」

name: Melphas
message: 「It seems Great Sage Paqy hasn't noticed anything in particular either...」

name: Synn
message: 「Somehow, it doesn't feel like yesterday was just yesterday」

name: Synn
message: 「...Still, Re-Crea is closing in right on our doorstep...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I wonder if even this peace might disappear...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, hey, what're you gettin' all gloomy for? Not like you」

name: Paqy
message: 「We've got two Demon Lords on our side, y'know? Nothin' to be scared of」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, duh! We won't lose to the selfishness of some god or whatever!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. I won't let this world, filled with everyone's feelings, be erased like it never existed!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hell yeah, that's the Demon Lord I know!」

name: Macaron
message: 「As long as I'm with Big Brother, it feels like I can do anything」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's keep doing our best starting tomorrow, too」
